Overview

A closer look

PrivacyGuard automates the operational side of privacy programs. It discovers personal data wherever it lives, keeps consent and lawful-basis records current, and automates data-subject request handling.

The result is a privacy program that runs continuously — not a binder that goes stale between annual reviews.

Capabilities

What you get

🔎

PII Discovery & Classification

Continuously discover and classify personal data across structured and unstructured sources.

📝

Capture, store and honor consent preferences across channels with full timestamping.

⚖️

GDPR & CCPA Enforcement

Pre-built controls map processing activity to GDPR and CCPA obligations.

📩

DSR Automation

Automate subject access, erasure and portability requests end to end.

Privacy by Design

Data Residency Options

Regional deployment choices for EU, US and other regulated workloads.

  • Privacy teams automating GDPR and CCPA record-keeping.

  • Enterprises preparing for privacy audits with limited headcount.
